describes: Surface cues for the epistemic nD facet, as DATA. A modality OVER a proposition: operator (K know / B believe) + holder (the knower) + proposition + certainty band + evidential source. The holder is an entity NP — its cues are CONSUMED from loomground-factual, not duplicated here.

operator_cues.pattern: \b(?:knows?|is aware|becomes? aware|has become aware|established that|it is known that)\b
\b(?:believes?|considers? that|is satisfied that|is of the (?:view|opinion) that)\b

source_cue: \b(?:on the basis of|based on|according to|in light of)\b\s*(?P<src>[^.;,]+)
